acceptance: Both probes (read=duckdb and read=postgres, write=duckdb, identify=True) emit bare ALL, proven by executing the SQL on duckdb.
Fork make check, make benchbox-dist and make benchbox-check pass; PR merged.
The fix is prepared as a candidate for an upstream submission and the PR notes its upstream status.
description: identify=True quotes ALL in GROUP BY ALL / ORDER BY ALL on the read=postgres, write=duckdb path (direct duckdb->duckdb is already fixed upstream). BenchBox _restore_group_order_by_all_keyword repairs it with a regex; baseline cases duckdb-group-by-all and duckdb-order-by-all are retain. Fix it in the fork's DuckDB generator.
